summary: November 19, 2025 enhancements: the Lightspeed section was removed from the left navigation, a fallback-authenticator feature adds fallback_authentication so local authenticators can fall back to controller credentials (with an option to clear it), and the Lightspeed intelligent assistant now supports OpenAI and Microsoft Azure as third-party LLM providers on operator and containerized installs.
questions: Can local authentication fall back to controller credentials?
Does Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant support OpenAI or Azure OpenAI?
Where did the Lightspeed menu go in the AAP navigation?

answer_card.title: Fallback authenticator and new LLM providers (Nov 19, 2025)
answer_card.answer_md:
- **fallback_authentication**: run custom logic when local authentication fails. Existing local authenticators, and those created at install, are set to fall back to controller credentials; you can clear the preset to stop falling back (AAP-56919).
- **Lightspeed intelligent assistant**: third-party LLM providers now include **OpenAI** and **Microsoft Azure**, on both OpenShift operator and containerized installs (ANSTRAT-1673).
- The Lightspeed section was removed from the left navigation bar (AAP-53006).
